card.name: Just before breast cancer hormone drug names
card.fires_on: Small linking words, commas or spaces right before an expected endocrine breast cancer drug name such as tamoxifen, fulvestrant or letrozole.

modes.label: Linking word before drug
modes.description: A word like or, and, on or of sits just before tamoxifen, fulvestrant or letrozole in a list or comparison.

card.plain: It fires on the word just before the name of a breast cancer hormone drug, as if predicting that name next.
